_comment: PER-REGION EMPIRE tile of the TWW3 Old World mod parchment, placed by the paired-anchor-dot workflow (user idea, 2026-08-14). The whole-map fit of this source is impossible - it draws different regions at inconsistent scale, so no single warp reconciles it (see the landmark-accuracy wall). The user crops the Empire out (alpha-erasing the rest) and draws matched colour dots on the crop AND on terraqueous_globe_reprojected.png, which IS the canvas/mask frame (8192x3616). The dot centroids, recovered by exact RGB, give source<->canvas correspondences. Revision 2026-08-17 (dots_1) used 7 paired dots spread to the region's edges - the original 3 (purple/orange/lime) plus four pushed toward the west and south perimeter (crimson far-west, mint far-south, olive north-centre, green south-west). With 7 (>=4) landmarks the thin-plate has a nonzero kernel term, so fit_registration.py bounds the lattice to the dots' hull+pad rather than the full frame - the deliberate fix the earlier 3-dot note foresaw for the 9-dot comb-smear: MORE, edge-spread dots, not fewer clustered ones. 2026-09-02: the 7-dot hull stopped at source-x~1043 of the crop's 1456 width, dropping the whole NE corner (Shiroki Forest/Southern Oblast/The Veldt/Draken Ridge/Delved) from every render - board diagnosis confirmed this was a genuine anchor-dot coverage gap, not a rendering bug. Two more dots (cobalt, amethyst), still on dots_1, extend the hull east toward Shiroki Forest/Ursi to recover that corner. The 7-pair global-affine residual is a tight mean 6.7 / max 10.5 px (the Empire barely curves under the source's projection: x/y affine scales ~0.446/~0.420, near-isotropic), so the thin-plate absorbs only small non-affine wrinkles at each dot. master_shape is the crop's native (h,w) = (1469,1456); the source is the dot-free, alpha-masked crop. This record only PLACES the tile; no geometry is extracted yet.
_comment_lattice: 6x6 over the dots' hull (fit_registration.py bounds the lattice to hull+pad for a 4+-dot thin-plate, because the r^2 log r kernel blows up outside the support hull and every downstream consumer re-fits its own RBF through the emitted control points - one wild extrapolated point smears into comb-streaks, as the 9-dot Empire tile showed on all four edges, 2026-08-16). The 9 dots span the Empire's perimeter (crimson at the far-west edge, mint at the far-south, purple at the north, cobalt/amethyst newly pushed toward the NE, lime at the east, green/olive across the interior-north), so the hull covers most of the crop and the periphery the lattice must extrapolate over is small.
_comment_landmarks: source px = dot centroid in the crop's own 1456x1469 frame (x,y); canvas px = the SAME dot's centroid read straight off terraqueous_globe_reprojected.png (= canvas space, no globe-fit indirection). Paired by the colour the user drew (pure marker palette: every channel in {0,63,127,191,255}). All marker colours were present in both frames as a single 12-px component each (4x4 bbox), no strays. These 9 ARE the fit for objective=landmarks. purple/orange/lime carry over unchanged from the prior 3-dot revision; crimson/mint/olive/green were the dots_1 edge-spread additions (2026-08-17); cobalt/amethyst are the 2026-09-02 NE-corner additions, still on dots_1.

record.notes: PROVISIONAL. Empire crop of the TWW3 Old World mod parchment ('The Old World, all faction starting positions v3.0'), registered against tools/derived/land_sea_mask.png by tools/fit_registration.py --seed tww3_old_world_mod_parchment_empire (objective=landmarks; 7 user-drawn paired anchor dots read direct off terraqueous_globe_reprojected.png, dots_1 revision => thin-plate placement, lattice bounded to hull+pad; 6x6 lattice). A DENSE Old World boundary network confined to the Empire - the whole-source fit is defeated by its inconsistent inter-region scale, so this per-region carve is the way in. Contributes NO coastline (the mask remains the sole authority, user decision #1) and no geometry yet: this request only PLACES it. precedence/layer_precedence are provisional placement values, to be revisited when boundary extraction lands (S6). PROVISIONAL until the user accepts the diagnostic render. MACHINE-FITTED; re-derive from the seed, do not hand-edit.
